note: Small family-run park in Yoder southeast of Hutchinson (3415 Switzer Rd), off K-96 and 12 mi from the Kansas State Fairgrounds: 20 full-hookup sites (10 pull-through), self-pay sign-in hut, reservations by phone. Bathhouse with showers, laundry and Wi-Fi; Yoder's shops and restaurants within walking distance. Many sites hold long-term residents. --Claude
summary: Operator site read today: 20 full-hookup sites (10 pull-through), 20/30/50 A, showers/laundry/Wi-Fi; $30/night (undated page, corroborated by two 7/2025 campers), $150/week, $450/month. Long-stay borderline (camper 7/2025: 'Mostly permanent/full-time rvs').
flags: LONG-STAY BORDERLINE (drop candidate for AWH, recommended keep): a 7/2025 camper wrote 'Mostly permanent/full-time rvs', and a 2022 monthly resident counted '11 other long-term RV'ers' (of 20 sites); the rate card offers $450/month. But the operator markets overnights ('a relaxing night or two'), runs a self-pay station for late arrivals, takes phone reservations, and two campers stayed single nights at $30 in July 2025. Not seasonal; Google 4.2 (50), RV Life 4 (17). Same camper: 'Property is in need of TLC ... Sites are right on top of each other.'
